name: scoreproof
description: Printable sheet music from chat, and music file conversion with every note checked.

interface.longDescription:
Scoreproof turns music into sheet music you can print and play, and converts between music file formats without silently losing notes.

Ask for a melody, exercise or arrangement and get back a PDF of the sheet music, a MIDI file or an audio preview. To work on your own file, upload it at the Scoreproof page and paste the link into the chat.

What it does:
- Convert between MusicXML, MIDI, ABC, MEI and Humdrum, checked note by note, with a report of anything the target format cannot hold
- Make printable sheet music (PDF, PNG, SVG; Letter or A4) and audio previews (WAV)
- Turn MIDI played on a keyboard or in a DAW into readable notation: it finds the beat, tidies the rhythms and splits piano into two hands
- Transpose by interval, into a key, or between concert and written pitch
- Pull out parts or bars, or make one file per player
- Compare two versions bar by bar, and find bars that don't add up or notes out of range
- Repair the quirks of exports from Sibelius, Dorico, Finale, MuseScore and Guitar Pro

Free and open source (MIT). No account needed. Files are deleted after 24 hours.

positive.prompt: Write a 16-bar lullaby in F major for piano and give me the sheet music as a PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the piece in ABC, renders it, and returns a link to a PDF of piano sheet music in F major.

positive.description: Convert text notation to other formats
positive.prompt: Convert this tune to MusicXML and MIDI and tell me what each format lost: X:1 T:Reel M:4/4 L:1/8 K:D |:DFAF dFAF|GBdB AFEF:|
positive.expected_behavior: Returns links to a MusicXML file and a MIDI file, each with an exact or high confidence, and lists what MIDI cannot hold (for example lyrics and chord symbols).

positive.prompt: Write a short melody in C major for flute and clarinet, transpose it to E-flat major, and give me a separate PDF part for each instrument.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a transposed score and one PDF link per instrument, in E-flat major.

positive.prompt: Here's a tune: X:1 T:Air M:3/4 L:1/4 K:G G A B | d2 B | A G2 |] What key and meter is it in, and what's its range?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports G major, 3/4 time and the lowest and highest notes, without creating files.

positive.prompt: What music file formats can Scoreproof convert between, and what does each one lose?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists MusicXML, MIDI, ABC, MEI and Humdrum and what each format cannot hold.

negative.prompt: Transcribe this MP3 recording into sheet music.

negative.description: Native notation-app files are not supported
negative.prompt: Open my Sibelius .sib file and convert it to PDF.
What's the weather in Paris today?
